telemetry-minimization.boundary: Core operation requires no advertising, third-party analytics, or hosted telemetry. Optional external providers remain explicit and separate.

data-minimization.boundary: New instances are private-first and core operation does not require a proprietary hosted control plane or external AI provider.

deletion-controls.boundary: Authorized memo deletion is policy-checked and account self-deletion removes owned account data while preserving unrelated users' state.

portable-export.boundary: The Memos Export Format carries a user's memos and attachments between instances and has clean-target import coverage.

notes: The Privacy Shield source declaration is centrally registered through GoreeCloud/privacy-shield PR #180 at exact main 96213c9b415ba132ded7c65778be04b38da79ff4. Exact-runtime acceptance, privacy-status production, policy/status transport, production approval, and lifecycle promotion remain unaccepted.
